card.name: Inside rare names, before the ending
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle or last piece of a rare proper name or drug name that is already partly spelled out, such as Gram-sci, Wool-f, vemur-afen-ib and levod-opa. It fires on a piece that is mid-name and followed by an ending.
